lines.text: People plan to go to a city, spend a year there, carry on business, and make a profit.
James says life is a mist that vanishes, so people ought to say, "If the Lord is willing."
James says boasting in proud intentions is evil, and knowing the right thing but not doing it is sin.
James tells the rich to weep, because their riches have rotted, thieves have stolen their clothes, and their gold and silver are corroded.
The rich withheld the harvesters' water, and they condemned and murdered the righteous, who did not resist them.
